svg.aria-label: How go-lint runs. Your repository's check command calls vlint through go run at a pinned version. vlint golangci writes .golangci.yml from the shared config plus your overlay, and vlint golangci -check fails when the committed file drifts. vlint ./... runs the seven analyzers: layout, clockseam, envroot, errstring, noskipenv, doccomment and adrref. golangci-lint then runs with the generated config.
